rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The second leaves line 1 an input; the project figures it as the instructions direct for a filer who used the IRA Deduction Worksheet (person.ira_nondeductible): i8606 p. 9, Line 1, "subtract line 12 of the worksheet (or the amount you chose to deduct on Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 20, if less) from the smaller of line 10 or line 11 of the worksheet". The other sources in the second's note are refused or the same: the Pub. 590-A worksheet (ira.kbh_short, ira.both_kinds), qualified reservist repayments (ira.special), the election to deduct less (ira.less_gate), and contributions with no deductible part, which the same subtraction gives with line 12 zero, contributions above the limit being refused (person.ira_over_limit, ira.over_comp).

Ruling: representation; project retained. Both take line 2 as the filer's amount: the project asks it (person.ira_basis) only of a person who files Form 8606 (person.ira_8606_line2), zero otherwise. i8606 p. 9, Line 2, "Generally, if this is the first year you are required to file Form 8606, enter -0-. Otherwise, use the Total Basis Chart". The wording of the project's question is a separate proposed finding, ruled in the render log for this line.

Ruling: representation; project retained. The project asks the question of each person (person.ira_dist) and shows the answer on the Form 8606 of a person who files it (f8606.dist, person.ira_dist_gate: nondeductible contributions and Yes); a Yes refuses line 14, and the deduction through person.ira_deduction, since lines 4 to 13 are not prepared. Form 8606 (2025), Part I, "In 2025, did you take a distribution from a traditional IRA, or make a Roth IRA conversion?" and "Go to line 4".

Ruling: model error (+ scope); Form 8606 (2025), Part I: "In 2025, did you take a distribution from a traditional IRA, or make a Roth IRA conversion?" is answered on the Form 8606 of a person who files it (i8606 p. 2, Who Must File: nondeductible contributions to a traditional IRA for 2025, among others). The project shows the answer through person.ira_dist_gate, which asks person.ira_dist only of a person with traditional IRA contributions who files Form 8606 (person.ira_has, then person.ira_dist_if_files); the reply copies person.ira_dist on every entry, so it needs that answer where the form is not filed. executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/f8606.json`; 1,702 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026; 2,558 comparisons): 2,144 agree; 397 candidate-unknown (170 on returns the interview completes, person[taxpayer].ira_dist or person[spouse].ira_dist not asked) and 17 project-refuses, all on refused returns where an upstream IRA screen refuses the person's IRA lines and the reply reads only the answer (stage16.refuse.ira.both_kinds, kbh_short, over_comp, person.ira_over_limit): scope. No value differs. person.ira_dist_gate was rewritten from all[ira_has, ira_files_8606, ira_dist] into a nested choose in that order (BUG-0471); no HEAD-to-current difference shows on f8606 over 1,702 fixtures and 500 generated returns. Project stands.
